about.title: A School Born to Reveal Every Child's Genius
about.mission: Founded in Nkozoa and accredited by MINEDUB, the Bilingual School Complex Les Génies d'Afrique was born from a deep conviction: every child carries exceptional potential. Our mission is to reveal it, nurture it and prepare them to excel in a globalised world.
about.vision: We aspire to become the bilingual school of reference in Cameroon, recognised for the quality of our guidance, the innovation of our teaching methods and the holistic development of our students.
about.values: Excellence, integrity, bilingualism and care form the foundation of our educational project. Every pedagogical decision is guided by the well-being and progress of each child entrusted to us.
about.bilingual: Our fully bilingual approach — French and English from day care — is far more than an advantage: it is an opening to two cultural worlds, a springboard to the best academic and professional opportunities.
about.excellence: From school farming to junior entrepreneurship, we go beyond official programmes to shape complete, creative and responsible individuals. Because tomorrow's leaders are shaped today.

cards.title: Francophone Programme
cards.subtitle: From Day Care to CM2
cards.description: Our French section follows the official MINEDUB curriculum, enriched with complementary content and progressive English immersion. A rigorous, caring and stimulating environment for every student.

cards.title: Anglophone Programme
cards.subtitle: From Nursery to Class 6
cards.description: Our anglophone section offers a rigorous curriculum fully aligned with MINEDUB guidelines. Teaching is conducted primarily in English, with French as a strong second language. Students are prepared for the best secondary schools.
strengths: French as a strong second language

whyUs.title: Why Choose Les Génies d'Afrique?
whyUs.subtitle: Strong values, an exceptional environment and an unwavering commitment to the development of every child.

items.title: Bilingual education
items.body: Full French–English immersion from day care. Two languages, two cultures, a passport to the world.

items.title: Discipline & values
items.body: A structured environment where integrity, respect and responsibility are cultivated daily.

items.title: Academic excellence
items.body: Enhanced official programmes, qualified teaching staff, exceptional results. Always aiming for the best.

items.title: Personalised support
items.body: Small class sizes, individual monitoring, attention to every child. Because every genius is unique.

items.title: Educational innovation
items.body: Farming, livestock, aquaculture, entrepreneurship: learning differently, creating, experimenting.

items.title: Creativity & expression
items.body: Arts and crafts, theatre, music, dance. Developing artistic talents and self-confidence.

items.title: Enhanced security
items.body: Secured premises, permanent supervision, strict child protection charter.

items.title: Global openness
items.body: International projects, cultural exchanges, digital technologies. Preparing tomorrow's citizens.

items.text: Since my son enrolled at Les Génies d'Afrique, I have noticed remarkable progress. He now speaks fluently in both English and French. The support is exceptional.
